title.narrative: Land Proj

description.narrative: Malawi Transport and Land Compact - Land Project: the Increased Land Productivity Project will support improved land services, better functioning land markets, and increased investment in land through revenue-oriented investments to increase adequate funding of land institutions at national and city levels and support institutional change in the land sector. Revenue work at both levels equally focuses on the broader role of well-functioning property tax systems in incentivizing productive use of land.

condition.narrative: Before the initial Disbursement of Program Funding for any property valuation campaigns funded under the Increased Land Productivity Project, the Government must adopt reforms and gazette any necessary implementing regulations permitting flexibility in the property valuation, to enable the use of automated valuation methods and computer assisted mass appraisal approaches to achieve sustainable efficiencies and equity from employing these methods.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
